purpose: Fixed check set for the intent classifier fix of 2026-11-24 (off-topic requests with no question word were labelled EMOTIONAL_OTHER and got the empathy reply instead of the course fallback). Written and hashed (intent_classifier_cases.sha256) BEFORE the classifier prompt or examples were changed; never edited afterwards. None of these messages is used as a classifier example. 'author' marks the six messages the author specified; the rest are held out.

expected_meanings.fallback: routed to retrieval, below the similarity threshold, so the student gets settings.FALLBACK_MESSAGE
expected_meanings.emotional: the fixed reply for the given label (plus a topic offer line if the message names a course topic)
expected_meanings.small_talk: the fixed small-talk reply, no classifier call
expected_meanings.answered: routed to retrieval and at or above the threshold, so the model answers from the course materials

cases.message: best nasi lemak in Shah Alam
good laptop for gaming under RM3000
suggest a good book to read
my exam is tomorrow and im panicking
cases.label: EMOTIONAL_STRESSED

cases.message: ugh sql is so hard i want to give up
cases.label: EMOTIONAL_STRESSED

scoring: A case passes when the route matches 'expect'. For 'emotional', any EMOTIONAL_* label passes (the replies differ only in wording); the expected label is recorded to report label agreement separately.
